_pattern_note: A candidate must carry at least one letter. The pure-digit patterns (\b[0-9]{7}\b, \b[0-9]{5,8}\b) were removed: they matched PO numbers, ZIP codes and bare amounts as material codes. None of the 7,260 codes in material_codes_reference.csv is pure-digit, and this list is only the DISCOVERY fallback for codes the backbone does not carry yet - a listed code is still matched by exact lookup regardless of these patterns.
_ocr_note: When auto_ocr is true, scanned PDFs are OCR'd automatically with no prompt. Engine order: rapidocr > tesseract > easyocr. When ocr_retry is true, a scan whose OCR dropped the quantities (text came back, the small digits did not) is re-rendered once at 1.6x the DPI, capped at 600. Raise ocr_dpi for a generally poor scan.
